description: Comprehensive Android permission risk assessment. Covers all dangerous (runtime) permissions, signature-level permissions, and special permissions. Each rule assesses the standalone risk of a single permission. Combination risks are handled by malware_indicators rules. Scoring: 5-15 normal, 20-35 moderate, 35-50 high privacy, 45-60 critical security.

rules.name: READ_SMS — Read All Messages
rules.description: Can read all SMS/MMS messages on device including banking OTPs, 2FA codes, and private conversations. Top permission abused by banking trojans for 2FA bypass.

rules.name: RECEIVE_SMS — Intercept Incoming SMS
rules.description: Can intercept incoming SMS in real-time before user sees them. Primary technique for stealing OTPs and 2FA codes. Can abort broadcast to hide messages from user.

rules.name: SEND_SMS — Send SMS Messages
rules.description: Can send SMS messages silently, potentially to premium-rate numbers incurring charges, or to spread malware via SMS links to contacts.

rules.name: RECEIVE_MMS — Intercept MMS Messages
rules.description: Can intercept incoming MMS messages including photos and attachments.

rules.name: RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH — WAP Push Messages
rules.description: Can receive WAP push messages. Abused by Joker/Harly malware families for automatic premium service subscription fraud.

rules.name: READ_PHONE_STATE — Phone Identity & State
rules.description: Can read phone number, IMEI, IMSI, SIM serial, carrier info, and active call state. Used for device fingerprinting and call monitoring.

rules.name: READ_PHONE_NUMBERS — Read Phone Numbers
rules.description: Can read the device's phone number(s). Used for victim identification and account association.

rules.name: CALL_PHONE — Make Phone Calls
rules.description: Can initiate phone calls without user interaction. Can be used to call premium-rate numbers, USSD codes for money transfer, or to redirect calls to attacker.

rules.name: READ_CALL_LOG — Read Call History
rules.description: Can read complete call history including numbers, timestamps, duration. Used for surveillance and social engineering reconnaissance.

rules.name: WRITE_CALL_LOG — Modify Call History
rules.description: Can modify or delete call history entries. Used by malware to hide evidence of premium-rate calls or USSD transactions.

rules.name: PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS — Intercept Outgoing Calls
rules.description: Can intercept, monitor, and redirect outgoing calls. Banking trojans use this to redirect calls to bank support to attacker's number.

rules.name: ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS — Answer Calls Programmatically
rules.description: Can answer incoming phone calls without user interaction. Can be used to silently answer and record calls.

rules.name: ADD_VOICEMAIL — Add Voicemail Messages
rules.description: Can add voicemail messages to inbox. Could be used for social engineering by leaving fake voicemails.

rules.name: USE_SIP — SIP Calling
rules.description: Can make/receive SIP calls. Could be used to bypass carrier billing controls.

rules.name: READ_CONTACTS — Read Contact List
rules.description: Can read entire contacts database including names, numbers, emails, photos, and linked accounts. Used for targeted phishing, spam campaigns, and social graph mapping.

rules.name: WRITE_CONTACTS — Modify/Delete Contacts
rules.description: Can add, modify, or delete contacts. Could inject malicious contact entries or destroy contact data.

rules.name: GET_ACCOUNTS — List Device Accounts
rules.description: Can enumerate all accounts (Google, email, social media) on device. Used for victim profiling, targeted attacks, and account takeover preparation.

rules.name: READ_CALENDAR — Read Calendar Events
rules.description: Can read calendar events including meeting details, locations, attendees, and notes. Privacy risk for corporate espionage and personal surveillance.

rules.name: WRITE_CALENDAR — Modify Calendar
rules.description: Can add, modify, or delete calendar events. Could inject fake meeting invites with phishing links or delete important reminders.

rules.name: CAMERA — Camera Access
rules.description: Can access front and rear cameras to take photos and record video. Used by spyware for silent surveillance, and by stalkerware to monitor victim's environment.

rules.name: RECORD_AUDIO — Microphone Access
rules.description: Can record ambient audio and phone calls. Used by spyware for wiretapping, meeting recording, and environment monitoring.

rules.name: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION — Precise GPS Location
rules.description: Can get precise GPS location (within ~3 meters). Used for stalking, movement tracking, and location-based targeting.

rules.name: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION — Approximate Location
rules.description: Can get approximate location via cell towers and WiFi (~100m accuracy). Less precise but still enables area-level tracking.

rules.name: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION — Background Location Tracking
rules.description: Can track location continuously in background even when app is not visible. Enables 24/7 movement surveillance without user awareness.

rules.name: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE — Read Files
rules.description: Can read all files on shared/external storage including photos, downloads, documents. Enables data exfiltration of personal files.

rules.name: WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE — Write/Delete Files
rules.description: Can create, modify, and delete files on shared storage. Used by ransomware to encrypt files, by droppers to write payloads, and to plant evidence.

rules.name: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE — Full File System Access
rules.description: Has unrestricted access to ALL files on device (Android 11+). Can read any app's files, databases, and shared data. Extremely powerful for data theft.

rules.name: READ_MEDIA_IMAGES — Read Photos (Android 13+)
rules.description: Can read all photos and images on device. Privacy risk from photo exfiltration.

rules.name: READ_MEDIA_VIDEO — Read Videos (Android 13+)
rules.description: Can read all videos on device. Privacy risk from video exfiltration.

rules.name: READ_MEDIA_AUDIO — Read Audio Files (Android 13+)
rules.description: Can read all audio files on device including voice recordings and music.

rules.name: BODY_SENSORS — Body/Health Sensors
rules.description: Can access body sensors like heart rate monitor. Sensitive health data that can reveal medical conditions and activity patterns.

rules.name: BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND — Background Health Monitoring
rules.description: Can read body sensor data continuously in background. Enables covert health surveillance.

rules.name: ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION — Physical Activity Detection
rules.description: Can detect user's physical activity (walking, running, driving, cycling). Used for behavioral profiling.

rules.name: BLUETOOTH_CONNECT — Bluetooth Device Access
rules.description: Can connect to paired Bluetooth devices. Could potentially access data from connected devices or inject commands.

rules.name: BLUETOOTH_SCAN — Bluetooth Scanning
rules.description: Can discover nearby Bluetooth devices. Used for proximity tracking and device fingerprinting.

rules.name: BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE — Bluetooth Advertising
rules.description: Can make device visible and advertise via Bluetooth. Low risk alone but unusual for non-BLE apps.

rules.name: NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES — WiFi Device Discovery
rules.description: Can discover nearby WiFi devices (Android 13+). Can be used for location approximation without location permission.

rules.name: INTERNET — Network Access
rules.description: Can access the internet. Required for virtually all malware for C2 communication and data exfiltration. Low risk alone but enables all network-based attacks.

rules.name: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE — Network State Info
rules.description: Can check network connectivity type and status. Used by malware to optimize data exfiltration timing.

rules.name: ACCESS_WIFI_STATE — WiFi Network Info
rules.description: Can read WiFi connection details including SSID, BSSID, signal strength. Used for location tracking via WiFi fingerprinting.

rules.name: CHANGE_WIFI_STATE — Modify WiFi Settings
rules.description: Can enable/disable WiFi, connect to networks, and scan. Could connect device to rogue access point for MITM attacks.

rules.name: CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE — Modify Network Settings
rules.description: Can change network connectivity state. Could manipulate connectivity to force traffic through attacker-controlled channels.

rules.name: NFC — Near Field Communication
rules.description: Can use NFC for reading/writing tags and card emulation. Could be used for NFC relay attacks on contactless payments.

rules.name: BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE — Accessibility Control
rules.description: THE most dangerous Android permission. Can read all screen content, intercept all input, perform clicks and gestures, overlay content. Used by 90%+ of banking trojans for credential theft, automated transfers, and 2FA bypass. The #1 vector for mobile malware.

rules.name: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW — Draw Over Other Apps
rules.description: Can draw overlay windows on top of all other apps. Primary technique for displaying fake login screens in banking overlay attacks. Second most abused permission after accessibility.

rules.name: BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN — Device Administrator
rules.description: Can become device administrator with power to enforce password policies, lock screen, wipe device, prevent uninstallation. Used by ransomware to lock device and demand ransom.

rules.name: BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE — Read All Notifications
rules.description: Can read, dismiss, and interact with ALL notifications from ALL apps. Captures banking OTPs, 2FA push notifications, email previews, and chat messages.

rules.name: BIND_VPN_SERVICE — VPN Service
rules.description: Can create a VPN tunnel routing ALL device traffic through the app. Enables complete traffic interception, DNS hijacking, and MITM attacks.

rules.name: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES — Install Other Apps
rules.description: Can prompt installation of additional APKs. Used by droppers to install the actual malware payload. Enables multi-stage infection.

rules.name: REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES — Uninstall Other Apps
rules.description: Can prompt removal of other apps. Could be used to uninstall security apps or competing malware.

rules.name: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES — See All Installed Apps
rules.description: Can enumerate ALL installed applications. Used by banking trojans to identify target banking apps for overlay attacks.

rules.name: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS — App Usage Statistics
rules.description: Can see which apps are used, when, and for how long. Used to detect when banking apps are opened to trigger overlay injection.

rules.name: WRITE_SETTINGS — Modify System Settings
rules.description: Can modify global system settings including display brightness, volume, timezone, and security settings.

rules.name: WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS — Modify Secure Settings
rules.description: Can modify secure system settings. Extremely powerful — can enable/disable ADB, change lock screen settings, modify accessibility settings.

rules.name: DISABLE_KEYGUARD — Disable Lock Screen
rules.description: Can disable the device lock screen. Used by ransomware to show overlay lock screens and by trojans to access device without user's PIN.

rules.name: WAKE_LOCK — Prevent Device Sleep
rules.description: Can keep device CPU/screen awake. Used by miners for continuous CPU usage and by spyware for uninterrupted surveillance.

rules.name: REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS — Battery Whitelist
rules.description: Requests exemption from battery optimization (Doze mode). Ensures background processes are not killed — critical for persistent malware operation.

rules.name: FOREGROUND_SERVICE — Foreground Service
rules.description: Can run persistent foreground services. Essential for continuous background operation including surveillance, location tracking, and C2 communication.

rules.name: FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA — Background Camera Use
rules.description: Can use camera from foreground service (Android 14+). Enables continuous camera surveillance in background.

rules.name: FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE — Background Mic Use
rules.description: Can use microphone from foreground service (Android 14+). Enables continuous audio recording in background.

rules.name: FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION — Background Location
rules.description: Can access location from foreground service (Android 14+). Enables continuous location tracking.

rules.name: RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED — Auto-Start on Boot
rules.description: App automatically starts when device boots. Core persistence mechanism — ensures malware survives device restarts. Alone it's common, but combined with dangerous permissions it's a red flag.

rules.name: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM — Exact Alarms
rules.description: Can schedule exact-time alarms (Android 12+). Used by malware for timed payload delivery and periodic C2 check-ins.

rules.name: USE_EXACT_ALARM — Use Exact Alarms
rules.description: Can use exact alarms without user approval (Android 13+). Enables precise timing for malicious task scheduling.

rules.name: POST_NOTIFICATIONS — Show Notifications
rules.description: Can display notifications (Android 13+). Could be used for phishing via fake banking notifications or social engineering.

rules.name: USE_BIOMETRIC — Biometric Authentication
rules.description: Can use fingerprint, face, or iris sensors. Generally legitimate for security, but could be part of a fake biometric prompt phishing attack.

rules.name: USE_FINGERPRINT — Fingerprint (Deprecated)
rules.description: Legacy fingerprint permission. Replaced by USE_BIOMETRIC in API 28+.

rules.name: VIBRATE — Control Vibration
rules.description: Can control device vibration. Very low risk, common in most apps.

rules.name: FLASHLIGHT — Control Flashlight
rules.description: Can control device flashlight. Very low risk.

rules.name: READ_PROFILE — Read User Profile (Deprecated)
rules.description: Legacy permission to read user profile data including name and contact info.

rules.name: READ_SOCIAL_STREAM — Read Social Stream (Deprecated)
rules.description: Legacy permission to read social media stream data from contacts provider.

rules.name: INSTALL_SHORTCUT — Create Home Screen Shortcuts
rules.description: Can create home screen shortcuts. Could place deceptive shortcuts mimicking banking or system apps for phishing.

rules.name: SET_WALLPAPER — Change Wallpaper
rules.description: Can change device wallpaper. Used by ransomware to display ransom demands as wallpaper.

rules.name: EXPAND_STATUS_BAR — Control Status Bar
rules.description: Can expand or collapse status bar. Used by overlay malware to prevent user from accessing quick settings.

rules.name: CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT — System Audio Capture
rules.description: Can capture audio output from all apps. System-level permission — enables recording of phone calls, media playback, and app audio.

rules.name: CAPTURE_VIDEO_OUTPUT — System Video Capture
rules.description: Can capture video output from all apps. System-level permission — enables screen recording of all activities including banking sessions.

rules.name: READ_FRAME_BUFFER — Read Screen Buffer
rules.description: Can read raw screen frame buffer. System-level permission — enables pixel-level screen capture without MediaProjection.

rules.name: READ_LOGS — Read System Logs
rules.description: Can read system log output. Logs may contain sensitive data, tokens, URLs, and error messages with internal paths.

rules.name: DUMP — Dump System State
rules.description: Can dump system service state. Provides deep insight into running processes, services, and system state.

rules.name: GET_TASKS — Get Running Tasks (Deprecated)
rules.description: Legacy permission to get list of running tasks. Still found in old malware targeting pre-Lollipop devices. Used to detect foreground banking app.

rules.name: REORDER_TASKS — Reorder Running Tasks
rules.description: Can bring tasks to front or push to background. Used by overlay malware to push legitimate app behind fake login screen.

rules.name: KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES — Kill Other Apps
rules.description: Can kill background processes of other apps. Could be used to kill security/antivirus apps.

rules.name: INTERNAL_SYSTEM_WINDOW — Internal System Window
rules.description: Can create internal system-level windows. Signature-level permission — if present in non-system app, indicates system-level exploit or platform signing key compromise.

rules.name: INSTALL_PACKAGES — Silent App Install
rules.description: Can install apps without user prompt. Signature/system permission — if present in non-system app, indicates system-level compromise or platform signing key leak.

rules.name: DELETE_PACKAGES — Silent App Remove
rules.description: Can uninstall apps without user confirmation. Signature/system permission — could be used to silently remove security apps.

rules.name: MOUNT_UNMOUNT_FILESYSTEMS — Mount Filesystems
rules.description: Can mount and unmount filesystems. Could be used to access additional storage or mount encrypted partitions.

rules.name: USER_PRESENT — Detect Screen Unlock
rules.description: Notified when user unlocks device. Used by malware to trigger overlay injection at the exact moment user starts using device.

rules.name: SMS_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTIONS — Financial SMS
rules.description: Can read SMS for financial transaction verification. Restricted permission — very suspicious if found outside banking apps.

rules.name: MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS — Control Active Calls
rules.description: Can manage ongoing calls including redirecting, muting, ending. Could hijack bank support calls.

rules.name: LOADER_USAGE_STATS — Content Loader Stats
rules.description: Can access content loader usage statistics. Provides insight into data loading patterns of other apps.

rules.name: ACCESS_NOTIFICATIONS — Legacy Notification Access
rules.description: Legacy permission for notification access. Replaced by BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE.

rules.name: CHANGE_CONFIGURATION — Change System Config
rules.description: Can change system configuration like locale and font size. Could be used to change device language to confuse user during attack.

rules.name: Samsung KNOX Permissions
rules.description: Requests Samsung KNOX enterprise permissions. If not a legitimate MDM/enterprise app, this is suspicious.

rules.name: Xiaomi Background Start
rules.description: Requests Xiaomi-specific background start permission. Enables persistent background execution on MIUI devices.

rules.name: Huawei Auto-Start
rules.description: Requests Huawei-specific autostart permission. Enables persistence on Huawei/EMUI devices.

rules.name: OPPO/Realme Auto-Start
rules.description: Requests OPPO-specific autostart permission.

rules.name: Unknown Custom Permission (Dangerous Pattern)
rules.description: Non-standard permission with dangerous-sounding name. Custom permissions with names containing 'admin', 'root', 'system', or 'install' are suspicious.

rules.name: BIND_TELECOM_CONNECTION_SERVICE — Telecom Service
rules.description: Can act as a telephony connection service. Enables call management and potentially call interception at system level.

rules.name: READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE — Privileged Phone Info
rules.description: Can read privileged phone state including IMEI on Android 10+. System/signature permission — very suspicious in non-system apps.
